name: missing_vs_present_eval
description: Held-out binary ASNE contrast for an expected item being found versus not found.

items.text: A person checks the desk and sees the signed form under the blue folder.
Someone opens the mailbox and sees the parcel resting behind the small door.
A person looks inside the backpack and sees the camera card in the side pocket.
A person checks the desk and sees only the blue folder without the signed form.
Someone opens the mailbox and sees the small compartment without the parcel.
A person looks inside the backpack and sees the side pocket without the camera card.
